_comment: How a Travel Itinerary PDF's form fields are named, so fill_itinerary can fill it.
This is DATA, not code: if the form changes its field names, adds rows, or wants a different
font size, edit this file — no new Gatherlight release needed. The PDF machinery itself stays
compiled and shipped with the app.
Run pdf_inspect on the blank form to see its real field names, then map them here.
'{n}' in a column field is replaced by the 1-based row number.
Copy this file to describe another form and pass its path as fill_itinerary's formMap.
